The '''Sujimis sector''' was a [[sector]] of [[the galaxy]] which contained the [[Pantora system]].<ref name="HttJ" /> The sector became part of the [[Occlusion Zone]] when the [[Nihil]] created the [[Stormwall]]<ref name="HRA1" /> in [[230 BBY]].<ref name="High Republic Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>  Following the [[Battle of Yavin]], the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] hid near the [[planet]] [[Orto Plutonia]] in the Sujimis sector.<ref name="HttJ" />
